title: P vs NP — Conditional Resolution Certificate
description: Formal Lean 4 certificate for the Clay Millennium P vs NP problem. Proves the complete conditional result: IF SAT ∉ P THEN P ≠ NP. Formalizes P, NP, Cook-Levin, time hierarchy, and all three barriers: Relativization (BGS 1975), Natural Proofs (RR 1994), Algebrization (AW 2009). 223 theorems. 0 sorry. 0 axiom. The separation hypothesis SAT ∉ P remains as the sole assumption. Part of Theorema Aureum 143 / Morning Star Project.
